concepts.way: misconception: wrong rule: a = b exchanges/copies values both ways (everyday symmetric reading of =)
concepts.why: The student reads a = b as a two-way exchange, but it only copies b into a, so b stays 20.

concepts.way: misconception: wrong rule: b = a exchanges the values of a and b.
concepts.why: One assignment does not swap two variables; the run gives b = 20, not 10.
The answer gives values but says nothing about variables themselves, and its mistake comes from misreading assignment.
